purpose: Estimate exposure-adjusted persistent behavioral feedback under two independent LLM families before confirmatory scaling.
taskSource: Reuse the 32 task hashes frozen in the MiMo v3 pilot: eight per category.
recommenderAllocation: The same balanced task-to-recommender-and-seed assignment is reused across LLM providers.
shamSemantics: held-sham-a and held-sham-b receive identical semantic task state and held recommendation activation but use independent provider calls and separate local cache scopes.

generation.privacy: Send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, utility, rank, and novelty features only.

pilotEstimands.persistentBehavioralFeedback: trace divergence and T3 Top-10 displacement greater than zero
pilotEstimands.adjustedPersistentFeedback: persistent feedback in immediate-versus-held minus persistent feedback in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b
pilotEstimands.adjustedTraceDivergence: trace divergence in immediate-versus-held minus trace divergence in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b

claimBoundary: This 32-task study is a cross-provider pilot. It can estimate reliability, stochastic divergence, and direction; it cannot establish confirmatory cross-LLM recurrence.
